7.name: The Afterglow
7.overview: Mel and Jack weigh Marley's offer — and debate honeymoon destinations — as they begin married life together. Brie and Mike confront their issues.

7.name: Beautiful Child
7.overview: Marley assesses Jack's fatherhood potential. Doc struggles to hold back when a patient seeks help. Brady searches for Lark — and his money.

7.name: The Match
7.overview: Mel, Jack and Marley examine more than the wares at a local flea market. Hope's campaign against Grace Valley hits a snag at a town hall meeting.

7.name: Pipe Dreams
7.overview: Jack and Mel prepare their unfinished home for a visit from a social worker. Brie does Brady a friendly favor. Doc takes a swing at something new.

7.name: Always Anywhere Forever
7.overview: Mel makes an unexpectedly dangerous house call. The sewing circle shares their concerns with Kaia. Hope and Doc get high on memories of young love.

7.name: No Regrets
7.overview: An abrupt arrival threatens to upend Mel and Jack's plans. Kaia and Brady team up to tackle a wildfire. Preacher makes an ambitious proposal.

7.name: It Takes A Village
7.overview: Doc faces off with Dr. Hayes at a pivotal medical board hearing. A baby shower pushes Lizzie to her breaking point. Clay opens up about his past.

7.name: Back In The Saddle
7.overview: Clay tries to buck his troubles by entering a high-stakes rodeo competition. Brie tracks an unlikely new lead in the search for Charmaine.

7.name: La Luna De Miel
7.overview: Eager to escape their worries, Mel and Jack embark on their honeymoon, where a freewheeling day trip takes a surprising turn.

7.name: David and Goliath
7.overview: The town gathers for a festive Founder's Day, where Hope stages a last-ditch effort to preserve Virgin River. Mel and Jack receive life-changing news.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Seeking a fresh start, a nurse practitioner moves to a remote Northern California town and finds that small-town life holds more surprises—and complications—than she expected.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Engagement. Babies. Heartbreak. Murder. For a small town, Virgin River has its fair share of drama — and Mel Monroe is often in the middle of it.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Mel and her loved ones in Virgin River support each other while facing all sorts of troubles: death, a fire, custody arguments, breakups and more.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: Mel navigates her new reality, Jack's past threatens his future, and new faces arrive — and stir things up — in Virgin River.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: Mel adjusts to a different pace of life, Jack works to grow his business, and the town faces new threats as secrets begin to surface in Virgin River.

seasons.name: Season 6
seasons.overview: New beginnings, uncovered secrets and second thoughts. As Mel and Jack prepare for the wedding, they learn more about each other — and their loved ones.
